situations.title: Find a place at the station
situations.scenario: You are at a UK train station and need to find a place.
situations.initial_prompt: Ask for the toilet in your own words.
situations.retry_orientation: Try again: begin with ‘Excuse me’ and ask where the place is.

situations.title: Find the exit
situations.scenario: You are in a nearby station passage and need to leave.
situations.initial_prompt: Ask for the exit in your own words.
situations.retry_orientation: Try again: start politely, then ask where the exit is.
